title: Leadership & Background
subtitle: Attolloo Group is led by Nils Johan Brede — combining four decades of operational computer science, executive leadership, and academic rigor.

sections.heading: 40-Year Thread:
sections.body: From algorithmic computing and economics at the University of Oslo (1983), through founding municipal internet portal networks (Lokalnett), cybersecurity turnaround (CEO Watchcom), and leading Privacy Tech at PwC Europe, to serving as CSO & HR Director at SPK.

sections.heading: Academic Capstone:
sections.body: Currently completing a Double Master in MBA & Master of Digital Business at ENEB Barcelona (Course grade: 95.36). The methodology stack represents 20+ years of applied practice academically validated through formal research.
